messages:
sarah_auditor: Hi everyone, auditor follow-up. We need a tight evidence bundle for SOC2: RBAC change history for 2025-02-10..2025-02-14, KMS decrypt events for the same window, vuln triage notes related to token-service, and an incident timeline that ties PR -> deploy -> who ran which runbook step. ETA?

laura_sec_eng: I can take RBAC PRs and GH audit log. Will collate PR diffs + approval snapshots.

mike_platform: I'll export CloudTrail KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for key alias "alias/ci-encrypt". Preference: redacted CSV + gzip + sha256. Also include the Splunk query I used.

jordan_sre: I have PD incident PD-4879 timeline and the on-call notes. I can grab the playbook excerpts showing the exact mitigation step and actor.

rachel_compliance: Reminder: auditors prefer a manifest.csv with columns: artifact_name, path_or_url, checksum, owner, produced_at. Also short README explaining redaction rules.

laura_sec_eng: Quick detail: RBAC changes came via platform repo PRs 8271 (role tighten) and 8282 (hotfix). Approvers: laura_sec_eng, mike_platform. Applies recorded by CI with `kubectl apply --record` so we can map commit -> apply.

mike_platform: Splunk query (paste for reproducibility):
```
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) "kms:keyId"="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345" | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters
```
Run for 2025-02-10T00:00:00 to 2025-02-14T23:59:59. I'll export CSV, gzip, compute sha256 and put in s3://redwood-auditor-exports/1835000123/kms-decrypts.csv.gz

laura_sec_eng: I'll generate PR diffs, GH approval audit logs, and a small CSV mapping PR -> CI build -> deploy timestamp. Example row: `pr_8271, https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8271, <sha256>, laura_sec_eng, 2025-02-12T02:58Z`

jordan_sre: Incident timeline short: PD-4879 opened 2025-02-12T03:12Z, primary mitigation 03:46Z, full mitigation confirmed 04:05Z. Postmortem draft link: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/PD-4879-draft (internal).

rachel_compliance: For vuln triage, include triage note summary: CVE-2025-1111 affecting token-service. Patch PR 129 applied 2025-02-12T04:10Z, exploitability rated low. Include ticket ID: VT-3412.

mike_platform: KMS details: keyId abcd-ef01-2345, alias/ci-encrypt, rotation enabled. CloudTrail raw path: s3://redwood-cloudtrail-logs/prod/2025/02/12/. I will not include full ARNs for principals in redacted sample.

laura_sec_eng: I'll also export the `kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml` snapshots before/after with sha256 for proof of change.

evidence-bot: Packaging initiated. Steps: collect listed artifacts, apply redaction rules (remove secrets, mask IPs to /24), compute sha256 for each file, generate manifest.csv and README.txt. Output location (staging): s3://redwood-auditor-delivery/staging/1835000123/

rachel_compliance: Also ensure we include a small CSV mapping decrypt event -> invoking principal -> related deploy PR if applicable (best-effort).

laura_sec_eng: Will attempt correlation where possible. For example, decrypt event at 2025-02-12T03:48:12 by arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/ci-deployer maps to CI build 2025-02-12T03:47Z which ran PR 8271.

mike_platform: I'll include the splunk search string and the exact commands I ran in a scripts/ folder (no secrets).

jordan_sre: I'll drop the runbook excerpt lines 10-22 showing who executed the step and the PD note referencing the exec.

laura_sec_eng: ETA: redacted sample bundle by EOD today; full, checksumed package by EOD tomorrow.

sarah_auditor: That works. Please ensure manifest.csv present and README explains redaction (IPs -> x.x.x.0/24, principal ARNs truncated after account id, times in UTC ISO8601). Also need one-line mapping in README: PR -> CI -> deploy -> runbook step IDs. Thanks :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: Redacted sample uploaded: s3://redwood-auditor-delivery/samples/1835000123-redacted-sample.tar.gz sha256: a3f4b2c9d5... . Full bundle pending.

laura_sec_eng: I'll ping here when final upload complete.
